profile: CG Oncology is a clinical biopharmaceutical company developing cretostimogene grenadenorepvec, an investigational oncolytic immunotherapy for bladder cancer. The company is evaluating the therapy in clinical trials for high-risk and intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, including as a monotherapy and in combination with another drug. Its activities include clinical development and preparation of a regulatory application for an initial indication.
